page_title: MON 4-0 NAN | Monaco v Nantes 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' A goal, which was scored by Lucas Michal (Monaco), was disallowed due to offside.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.

88' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.

87' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for an infringement. Nantes win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
84' Here comes a substitution. Folarin Balogun is given a rest as he is replaced by Lucas Michal (Monaco).
80' 11:21 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
80' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
79' The game is interrupted now, Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Substitution. Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) replaces Mohamed Camara.
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nicolas Cozza will be replaced by Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes).
77' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Douglas Augusto (Nantes) replaces Matthis Abline.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is replacing Eliesse Ben Seghir.

76' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. That's a free kick to Monaco.
72' Eray Comert (Nantes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Romain Lissorgue signals. Monaco are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
71' Nantes are ruled offside.

70' The game is interrupted. Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. There is a free kick near the sideline to Monaco.
69' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) brings his opponent down. Romain Lissorgue has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Monaco.
68' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Monaco.
63' The game has come to an end for Krepin Diatta. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Wilfried Singo (Monaco).
63' Antoine Kombouare decides to make a substitution. Kelvin Amian will be replaced by Florent Mollet (Nantes).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benie Traore departs the field of play to be replaced by Kader Bamba (Nantes).
61' 4 - 0 Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alban Lafont with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 4:0.
60' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
60' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.

60' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Folarin Balogun (Monaco). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Benie Traore (Nantes) takes a short corner kick.
58' Benie Traore (Nantes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Nantes will have an opportunity.

57' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Monaco are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
56' Benie Traore (Nantes) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
54' A corner kick by Nantes is thwarted by the well prepared Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco).
54' A cross from Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Nantes force a corner. They send men into the box.
53' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Nantes have a free kick.
48' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Adi Hutter gives a chance to Saimon Bouabre (Monaco) and Mamadou Coulibaly is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
41' The referee shows a yellow card to Moussa Sissoko (Nantes). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
41' Surely that's handball by one of the Monaco players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
41' What a great touch by Tino Kadewere (Nantes) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the centre of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
40' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
37' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a free kick to Nantes, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
36' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) receives a yellow card. Romain Lissorgue interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kelvin Amian (Nantes). Monaco have been awarded a free kick.
33' Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
31' Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Nicolas Pallois is substituted due to injury. Antoine Kombouare gives a chance to Tino Kadewere (Nantes).
28' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' The rebound finds Caio Henrique (Monaco) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance! The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
27' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Folarin Balogun (Monaco), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the left post. He did everything right but score!
26' Marcus Coco (Nantes) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
24' 3 - 0 Goal! Mohamed Camara (Monaco) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Alban Lafont to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
23' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
23' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Monaco are awarded a penalty kick!

21' The referee shows the yellow card to Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco). Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Romain Lissorgue saw the whole situation. Nantes will take a free kick.
15' A truly beautiful footballing moment. Benie Traore (Nantes) takes the free kick from a very promising position, but the goalkeeper thwarts the effort with an amazing save.
15' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle after Krepin Diatta (Monaco) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Free kick. Nantes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

13' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.

12' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Caio Henrique flights the free kick into the box, where Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 2:0.
11' The Monaco players joy may have been justified, because referee Romain Lissorgue is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
10' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
10' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) will take the free kick.
9' Eray Comert (Nantes) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick to Monaco.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Krepin Diatta provides Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the top right corner. 1:0.
1' Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul after Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Nantes will take a free kick near the side line.
1' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a free kick to Monaco, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Romain Lissorgue.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
